subject: Avoid unnecessary slot computing in KEYS command. (#12843)
reason: The change only moves the patternHashSlot computation in keysCommand behind the existing server.cluster_enabled guard. pslot is initialized to -1 and is now assigned only when cluster_enabled && !allkeys, so the new condition `pslot != -1` selects the single-slot iterator under exactly the same circumstances as the old `server.cluster_enabled && !allkeys && pslot != -1`; in standalone mode the slot was computed before but never used. patternHashSlot is side-effect free, so no reply, iteration order, expiry handling, or crash path differs between the builds for any input in any mode.
